structured.answer: I haven't decided, and I'll ask you or the bank. The page puts something called "פסגות" at the top, and with its own numbers, 10,000 ₪ now and 500 ₪ a month (70,000 ₪ in total), I'd have about 86,045 ₪ after ten years, but I'm not sure that's money I'd actually have. Leumi would give 82,968 ₪, and the fund the page puts in is "אי.בי.אי. מחקה ת"א 125 (4A)", though I don't know what "מחקה" means.

stuck.why: It opens with 'להשקיע במדד' and English buttons (MSCI, S&P 500). Without the task I would have left right there. To me מדד is the price index on the news.
The boxes already said 10,000 and 500 and the return box said 7. I didn't know whether to change them, and I don't touch sliders, so I left them as they were.

stuck.where: Screen 2, 'בכסף של היום' and the 'אינפלציה' button
stuck.why: Is 86,045 ₪ what I'll really have, or something worked out for inflation? I didn't press the button.
A minus sign. It scared me, and I wasn't sure who loses what.
Too many numbers, two on each line (86,045 and 1,049). I worked out that the small one is the cost, but I'm not sure.
